title: ToolLabel
description: The label of a tool call, built by the backend from what the engine sent, which the client translates and never builds (plan 28, D-02). The adapter of the engine is the one that reads the call; a client that met an unknown `messageKey` shows the generic line.

messageKey.description: An i18n key of `sessions.tool.*`, one per way of labelling a kind — `sessions.tool.fileEdit`, `sessions.tool.searchIn`, `sessions.tool.other`.

params.description: The values the key interpolates, strings and numbers only: a path relative to the session's folder, the lines added and removed, the first line of a command, a pattern, a host, a query, a server and its tool, the engine's own name for a tool of kind `other`.
